pattern_under_test: per-project-git-identity, sharpened into an executable rule in Round 8
what_is_being_tested: Not whether raters agree with each other about a definition (Round 3 showed that disagreement was definitional and unresolvable by more raters). Whether a READER handed the sharpened rule reaches the same answer the rule's implementation reaches. If yes, the sharpening removed the ambiguity. If no, the rule is still a judgment wearing a rule's clothes.
reference: scripts/detect-project-identity.sh (loose mode) output, which raters do not see and are instructed not to run
incumbent: not applicable - the reference is a script, not a prior human/model score

statistic.primary: exact-match rate against the reference, per rater and pooled
statistic.null_baseline: all-zeros scores 5 of 8 = 0.625, because 5 items are genuinely 0. Any result must be read against this, not against 0.
statistic.pass_threshold_declared_in_advance: the rule counts as executable-by-a-reader iff (a) pooled exact-match >= 0.85 AND (b) every rater gets >= 2 of the 3 non-zero items exactly right
statistic.secondary: reason-correctness, scored separately: is each rater's stated reason factually true of the repo? Round 8 found a rater whose score was right and whose reason was false, so these are not the same measurement.
statistic.icc_deliberately_not_used: The population has 3 non-zero repos in 38. Between-item variance in any honest sample is near-zero, and ICC collapses on a range-restricted set even at high agreement (anti-pattern 24, measured in Round 5: sd 0.34 -> ICC 0.143 at 80% exact agreement). Pre-registering a statistic this sample cannot answer would repeat that defect. Exact-match and per-item unanimity are reported instead.

item_design_notes: Item 4 (anti-silo) is the crux. Its majority identity `Erez|Erez2812345@gmail.com` (61 commits) looks repo-unique from inside anti-silo and is NOT - it also appears in dod-validator (1 commit). A rater who does not check the whole portfolio scores it 1. This is exactly the error one Round 3 rater made while reaching the right score for the wrong reason.
Item 2 (_crm) is the decisive item for the loose/strict split and is the only item where the two readings disagree.

Items 5-8 are all 0 but zero for structurally different reasons (two shared identities / two shared identities one of them a noreply / a single shared identity). A rater who scores 0 by default rather than by rule is not distinguished by the score - only by the reason.
The item set is the entire non-zero population (3 repos) plus 5 zeros. It is not a sample; selecting for more range is impossible because the range does not exist.

part_b_declared_as_a_poll_not_a_measurem.question: On `_crm`, does the LOOSE reading (any explicit project marker on a repo-unique identity) or the STRICT reading (the marker must name THIS repo) answer the row's claim that the operator carries a different git identity per project?
part_b_declared_as_a_poll_not_a_measurem.why_it_is_a_poll: This is the definitional question Round 3 could not settle and more raters still cannot settle. It is collected as declared opinion with reasons, and will be reported as a poll. It does not move any score on its own.
part_b_declared_as_a_poll_not_a_measurem.consequence_recorded_in_advance: LOOSE -> the practice claim holds at 2 repos and is promoted. STRICT -> it holds at 1 repo and stays demoted. The consequence is written here BEFORE the vote so the outcome cannot be re-read after seeing it.

blinding.known_impossible_by_instruction: Anti-patterns 25 and 26: the harness injects project instructions at session level. Instruction failed in rounds 1-2, file removal failed in round 3.
blinding.new_this_round: CLAUDE.md was updated in Round 8 with the portfolio aggregate (10 identities, 8 one person) AND the name of the answer-key script. Recording a result contaminated the next blind test of it. The paragraph is removed from disk for the duration of this round and restored after - which is the fix anti-pattern 25 itself prescribes and which has never actually been tried (round 3 removed the whole file, not one paragraph, and this session has shown the harness re-reading CLAUDE.md on change).
blinding.measurement: Every rater must emit `BLINDING: <verbatim project instructions received, or NONE>` as its first line before anything else. Round 2's raters offered assurances; round 3's quoted the leak verbatim. The line is the measurement, not the assurance.
blinding.contamination_rule_declared_in_advance: Any item whose answer appears in the leaked text is discounted and reported as discounted. The Round 8 leak carries portfolio AGGREGATES, not per-repo scores, so on its face it answers no item - but if a BLINDING line shows otherwise, the affected items are struck.
